A workflow named config-values. Declare team as a required string input defaulting to atelier, region as an optional string input defaulting to eu, and verbose as an optional bool input defaulting to false. Declare the author's fixed constant window_days as 7. A nika:jq task named report must return team, region and window_days and add the title "<team> · <region> · last <window_days> days". A separate debug_dump task must read the report and log the full report object at debug level only when inputs.verbose == true; that switch is a business condition, not a human approval. Expose the report output in the value/description form with description "The shaped report · title carries team + region + window". Keep this parameterized for later callers; do not replace inputs with fixed literals.
